hero.outcome: Hire faster with AI that screens, schedules, and scores.
hero.description: Coordinated agents that screen, schedule, and score candidates so recruiters focus on the best-fit conversations.

problem.title: Hours lost to screening and scheduling
problem.description: Recruiters spend much of their day reading resumes and coordinating interviews. High-volume pipelines are slow, and strong candidates can slip through before a person ever sees them.

outcome.title: Recruiters back on the conversation
outcome.description: Prime Agentic screens and ranks applicants, coordinates interview times, and surfaces a shortlist so recruiters spend their time on the conversations that decide the hire.

features.title: Resume screening
features.description: Agents review and rank applicants against the role requirements.

features.title: Interview scheduling
features.description: Agents coordinate times across candidates and interviewers.

features.title: Candidate scoring
features.description: Agents score applicants on role fit and surface an explainable shortlist.

features.title: Pipeline visibility
features.description: A shared view of every stage, from application to offer.

steps.title: Plan
steps.description: Agents turn the role description into screening and scoring criteria.

steps.title: Execute
steps.description: Agents screen applicants, schedule interviews, and rank candidates.

steps.title: Adapt
steps.description: As interviewers give feedback, agents refine the shortlist and next steps.

useCases.title: Staffing agencies
useCases.description: Work more requisitions at once with faster screening and scheduling.

useCases.title: In-house talent teams
useCases.description: Keep a consistent, explainable pipeline across every open role.

useCases.title: High-volume hiring
useCases.description: Screen large applicant pools and surface the candidates worth a conversation.

faqs.question: When will this be available?
faqs.answer: [PLACEHOLDER] The platform is in development; availability timing will be announced.

faqs.question: Is there an early access program?
faqs.answer: [PLACEHOLDER] Early access details are still being defined.

faqs.question: What does this demo show?
faqs.answer: The demo is an illustrative walkthrough of the coordination approach, using a fictional role and mock candidates.

faqs.question: Does the AI make hiring decisions?
faqs.answer: No. Agents screen, schedule, and rank to support the process; a human recruiter makes the final decision.
